caption: ultimate alien's world tour - new ultimates, a globe-hopping tour and the ps2's late-license send-off.
about: Ben 10 ultimate alien: cosmic destruction (2011) is the ps2's late-era ben 10 entry: the ultimate alien forms join the omnitrix rotation, the tour stretches from paris to tokyo, and the combat layers upgrades onto the familiar swap-mid-fight law. It is also one of the last licensed brawlers the console received, which gives it a small archival seat of its own.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
